title: and First Lady Melania Trump lay a wreath at the September 11

description_long: At the Pentagon on September 11, 2025, President Donald Trump and first lady Melania Trump attended a ceremony marking 24 years since the September 11 attacks, which killed nearly 3,000 people. The Associated Press and NBC News reported that families and dignitaries gathered for commemorations in New York, Virginia, and Shanksville, Pennsylvania; in lower Manhattan, relatives and loved ones read victims’ names.
